task: Two juice ideas: skill point count and swell, cycle-end pulse
handoff: Idea 1: the skill point count in the top bar counts up (warm flash) or down when spent and swells to 1.18 for 0.22 s (new Juice.pop, POP_SCALE/POP_SECONDS tunables). Why: earning and spending the biggest currency was an instant text swap. Idea 2: the cycle counter pops (1.12) and flashes warm when a cycle ends. Why: marks the moment income lands. Both obey Juice.motion (0 = old behaviour). No state or text changes; hooks: main.gd _last_points var, calls in _refresh and _end_cycle. Tests: suite 507/507 (the win-run tests fail intermittently when another agent shares the scratch HOME; they failed on a clean tree too). Not checked by eye: swell size on the top bar layout (pop scales about the centre inside a container), warm flash legibility on the points label, cycle flash overlapping the progress bar.

hooks: main.gd: _last_points, Juice.pop/count_to on points_label in _refresh, Juice.pop/flash on cycle_label in _end_cycle
